arjun: quick note 1: onboarding sampleapp users hitting streaming see intermittent SSE parse errors + duplicate terminal events around auth refresh. repro on web + android.
nina: can you paste a tiny repro and logs?
arjun: steps: open sampleapp, start stream, wait ~40s (we jitter refresh). sometimes client logs 'parse error: unexpected \n' then UI shows two DONE frames. logs: [2026-03-22T18:02:40Z] sse: connected
[2026-03-22T18:03:20Z] auth: refresh start
[2026-03-22T18:03:20Z] sse: recv id=321 data="part1"
[2026-03-22T18:03:20Z] sse: recv id=322 data="part2"
[2026-03-22T18:03:20Z] client: parse error: unexpected "\n"
[2026-03-22T18:03:20Z] client: reconnect last_event_id=322
[2026-03-22T18:03:20Z] sse: recv id=322 data="part2" // duplicate
[2026-03-22T18:03:20Z] sse: recv id=323 data="!" // arrives after duplicate -> UI ordering off
nina: parity check: web sampleapp aborts XHR on refresh; android waits for inflight to finish. that mismatch could surface different flakes. also our SDKs differ in SSE parsing: web emits per data-line, android emits on full event newline.
dave: proposed fixes:
- standardize parse semantics across SDKs: emit only on complete SSE event (headers + blank line).
- change web sampleapp to avoid abort() during refresh; instead attach a header on the next connect to trigger resume server-side.
- implement short client-side dedupe window (3s) keyed by event id, fallback to checksum.
- server ticket to ensure resume is atomic (don't re-emit final event during handshake).
- small onboarding UX blurb: "If a stream reconnects while refreshing credentials, content will be deduplicated and the app resumes."
ci-bot: created job sse-parity-tests, infra ticket INF-4210 created for resume atomicity.
arjun: i'll open a tiny PR for web sampleapp + README update, and a follow-up for SDK dedupe heuristic. nina, can you coordinate android parity change?
nina: yes, i'll push android change and unit tests to force refresh at 30s and validate single terminal event.
dave: also add telemetry counter sse.resume.duplicate with sdk tag so we can split web/android.
arjun: thanks. let's ship the sampleapp UX patch to staging first, watch telemetry for 24h. reopen if we see regression. :white_check_mark:
